entries.zh: 铁链、铁锁链；脚镣（grillos 17 世纪义为缚足铁链）
entries.en: iron chains; fetters, shackles
entries.notes: 汉字鉄練与西语 grillos（17 世纪义'脚镣'）互证清晰，唯声调号一处污損（T99）故按规降级

entries.en: leg-fetters, iron shackles for the feet (grillos de los pies)
entries.notes: 汉字[疑:鏈/連]；依 quy ca cu 与西语 de los pies 取'鏈'，义为脚镣

entries.en: leg-irons, fetters for the feet
entries.notes: 汉字[疑:鐐/罕]；依 lo ca 与西语 grillos de los pies 取'鐐脚'即脚镣

entries.en: cricket (chirping insect); 'crickets that sing'
entries.notes: 音写[疑:gyur/fyur]且声调污損（T99）；依'蟋'字与 grillos que cantan 定为蟋蟀

entries.zh: 鸣叫之虫（蟁，蚊之古字；一说蟊）
entries.en: a chirping insect; character uncertain: 蟁 (old form of 蚊 'mosquito') or 蟊 (crop pest)
entries.notes: 字形[疑:蟁/蟊]且声调污損（T99）；蟁为蚊古体，与西语'会鸣之虫'仅部分吻合，释义存疑

entries.en: chirping insects listed together: 蟁 (old form of 蚊) and 蟋 (cricket)
entries.notes: 两处声调均污損（T99）且 gy/fy 存疑；依'蟁蟋'二字与 grillos que cantan 取鸣虫并举义

entries.en: to shout, to roar, to cry out loud
to yell to scare off, to shout someone away (espantar: to frighten)
clamor, uproar, shouting (gritería)
entries.notes: Griferia 依閙(láu)与 M lau 定为喧嚷；视作 17 世纪 gritería 之别写

entries.en: boiling hubbub, clamor of voices
to raise a commotion, noisy stir
entries.notes: 第二音节[疑:fong/tong]；依'閙動'组合与 griferia 取闹动义

entries.en: clamor and uproar (alboroto), loud quarrelsome shouting
a furious shouter, one who rages and howls (gritón furioso)
entries.notes: 字形[疑:逞/延]且声调污損（T99）；M 音 Feng 与西语 furioso 相合（或为瘋类字），字形未定故降级

entries.en: tumultuous uproar, riotous clamor
to shout and clamor
entries.notes: 声调污損（T99）；'嚷'字与 griton（喊嚷）义相合

entries.en: one who stirs up the house with shouting (alborota la casa)
entries.notes: '攪'字[疑:攪/搯]且一声调污損（T99）；依 guiau que 与西语 alborota la casa 取'搅家'义

entries.en: to bawl and shout so that something be done; to yell orders
entries.notes: 西语短语略残讹（gritar y calle 或为 callar 之讹），依'吼喝'二字取叱喝义

entries.en: a shout, the sound of yelling
entries.notes: 一声调污損（T99）；依'吼聲'二字取喊声义，西语短语残讹故以汉字为准

entries.zh: 粗鲁、粗脚粗手（举止粗野）
entries.en: coarse, rude; clumsy and uncouth (rough of foot and hand)

entries.zh: 粗野之人（南雷人，字面待考）
entries.en: an uncouth, uncivilized person; grosero without policia (17c policia: civility, polished conduct)
entries.notes: 西语残讹（nos ne policia 疑为 no [sabe] policia '不知礼义'）；'南雷人'与 grosero 粗野义相合但字面存疑（或为南蠻人之讹），语义无法定夺故降级
